pages.title: Growing Strawberries
pages.text: Plant strawberry seeds on TFC farmland. This is a single-block crop. Break the fully grown crop to harvest $(item)Strawberries$() and recover a seed.$(br2)Growth conditions:$(br)$(bold)Temperature$(): 5–28°C$(br)$(bold)Hydration$(): 35–85%$(br2)Manage the soil and nutrients using TFC's farming rules.

pages.title: Harvest and Wild Crops
pages.text: Both cultivated strawberries and mature wild strawberry crops yield TFC's $(item)Strawberries$() ($(item)tfc:food/strawberry$()).$(br2)Break a wild strawberry crop to obtain a seed. Mature wild crops also provide fruit. Grow the seeds on farmland to continue cultivation.
